description:
• Brand introduction:

At Verve Moda, we recognize that the accessories you use daily aren't just objects—they're an extension of your style and values. In a world of fleeting trends and fleeting moments, we believe in the power of lasting impressions. This is why our drive goes beyond just creating accessories.

We infuse exceptional design into each piece, carefully selecting luxurious yet conscious materials that respect both your aesthetic and the earth. With us, your everyday essentials are transformed into extraordinary treasures. Choose Verve Moda, where every accessory is not just a statement of style but a nod to a sustainable future.


• Product description:

We sell accessories made out of amazing materials. Our first collection uses Alcantara which is an Italian-made synthetic suede that is extremely luxurious to touch and very durable. It's used in high-end super cars like Ferraris, Lamborghinis, Porsche, McLaren, and more but also luxury fashion brands like Louis Vuitton.


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

- The accessories we make are made from amazing materials that are sustainable, cruetly-free luxury materials. These materials are used in high-end super cars like Ferraris, Porsche, McLaren, and more but also luxury fashion brands like Louis Vuitton.

- They're made with precision to perfectly fit your devices like your iPhone, Apple Watch or Airpods. 

- Beyond elegance, Alcantara's velvety touch caresses the senses, invoking a profound emotional connection.

- Its enduring nature and ease of care make Alcantara a companion for a lifetime, embodying resilience and reliability.


• Payment terms:

Within 5 business days after 30-days of purchase. 


• Other information:

No limits on number of referrals. Only 1 referral per unique customer. If a customer comes in thorugh an ad running on a platform like Facebook or Instagram as their first touch, the referral will be accredited to that instead of the affiliate.
